The C- inspection work started on 25.11.2024 by the customer and their contractor" M/s Vasavi Power". The disassembly of the thermal block was completed by 01.12.2024. Mechanical completion of the unit was done by 20.12.2024 and the Motor roll was done 21.12.2024. Summary The author reported at site on 25th November 2024 to carry-out the C-Inspection of GT02. The C- inspection work started on 25.11.2024 by the customer and their contractor" M/s Vasavi Power". The disassembly of the thermal block was completed by 01.12.2024. Mechanical completion of the unit was done by 20.12.2024 and the Motor roll was done 21.12.2024. Subsequently the unit was started up successfully on 22.12.2024 by the customer.  During this outage the following work was carried out.  The GT vane rows-1 and 2 was replaced with re-conditioned vanes, during this C-inspection.  The inlet segments were replaced with new segments.  The stator heat shield- B was replaced with new heat shields.  All assembly materials used for re-blading of GT blades & vanes are new.  The GT Rotor blade rows 1 and 2 are replaced with reconditioned blades.  The Hot gas casing was re-used even though there was cracks on weld joints as well as it crossed the life time but there was no spare HGC(customer`s decision)

Work carried out 3.1 Filter House: Inspection and maintenance of the filter house was done by the customer. 3.2 Air Intake manifold: Found in dirty condition with some signs of minor corrosion in some spots. Action: Intake manifold was cleaned prior to assembly. 3.2.1 Air inlet casing Found dirty with black sticky deposits. Action: The casing was cleaned and inspected prior to assembly. ANTA GT02 C 14 -Inspection report 31.12.2024 3.2.2. Inlet Guide Vanes During disassembly, all IGV’s were found in dirty condition with black deposits. Action: All IGV's were cleaned prior to assembly. 3.3. Compressor casing 3.3.1 Compressor casing (front section). Found dirty with black deposits on vanes as well as on the casing. All compressor vanes and blades were cleaned manually. Vane rows-17 & 18 was found with rubbing marks on lower half. Action: All compressor vanes and blades were cleaned manually. All the vanes with rubbing marks are de-burred. 3.3.2. Blow off Valves stages 1 ,2 and 3. In general, found the valves in dirty condition. Action: Dismantled all four valves and cleaned all the parts. Re-assembled the valves after replacing all the soft parts (Teflon seals, piston guides, O-ring etc.). Done leak test (with air supply) of all the valves and found okay. 3.4. Compressor Diffuser The compressor diffuser inner and outer was found in good condition. The grooves(for HGC) on the compressor diffuser found with some heavy fretting. Action: Split line and threads were cleaned and inspected prior to assembly. All sealing surfaces, keys/keyways were cleaned and inspected prior to assembly. During this outage, all the entry segments and vane head seal segments on both the halves were replaced. The fretted area of the suspension groove on both the halves were re-built by welding and ground to the size as per the drawing. 3.5. Rotor assembly 3.6.1 Rotor In general, the Rotor found in good condition. The labyrinth seal D found damaged; the seal strips were broken off. The damaged labyrinth seal-D, partially (9 rows replaced out of 15) replaced with new seals and the height of the seal was ground manually and set to the height as per the drawing. Two blades on compressor row-1 was found with impact damages(dent on LE) and an ER case (ER-20241206-0472 )was raised with GE Engineering. GE Engineering recommended to replace the two damaged blades with new spares as the size of damage is beyond the limit as per the repairing criteria. But customer decided not to replace but to blend it by filing the damaged area. Action: • The damaged labyrinth seal D is replaced with new spares. • Done de-burring of the rubbed compressor blade rows. • Done cleaning of the complete rotor, compressor blades and coupling flanges. • The GT blade rows 1 replaced during the outage with reconditioned blades. • The GT blade row-2 was replaced with 106 reconditioned blades and 1 used blade with serial number FGTI887C (used for 16,000EOH on another unit)

. • The GT blade row-2 was replaced with 106 reconditioned blades and 1 used blade with serial number FGTI887C (used for 16,000EOH on another unit). ER case was raised with GE Engineering and got approval to re-use that one blade for one cycle only(ER case ER-20241202-0877) • NDT was carried out by customer`s vendor on all GT blades and RHSS and no flaws were reported. ANTA GT02 C 14 -Inspection report 31.12.2024 • The complete Rotor was cleaned and inspected prior to re-assembly. • All the balancing weights were removed from compressor end prior to assembly of the Rotor as recommended by the Balancing Engineer(third party, organized by the customer). 3.6.2 Overspeed protection device Found in good condition. 3.7 Bearing assembly 3.7.1 Turbine journal bearing • The journal bearing was cleaned and visually inspected and found good. • NDT (DPT & UT) was carried out on the bearing shells and found no flaws. • The dimensional check was done, and the jacking oil pockets were inspected and found okay. • The thermo-couples were inspected and reused by the I &C team of the customer. 3.7.2 Compressor bearing • The journal bearing was cleaned and visually inspected and found good. • NDT (DPT & UT) was carried out on the bearing shells and found no flaws. • The dimensional check was done and found in tolerance. • The thermo-couples were inspected and re-used by the I &C team of the customer. 3.7.3 Thrust bearing • The complete thrust pads were dismantled and inspected visually and NDT (DPT & UT) was done on the thrust pads and found no flaws. • The thrust bearing clearance during dismantling and re-assembly is found in tolerance. 3.8. Combustion chamber Refurbishment of the combustor was done under the supervision of the Hot gas path Specialist from GE/FC. The inner liner is replaced with reconditioned one with TBC. The full set of tile carriers were replaced with new set. The tile carrier collar was not able to insert into the collar of the inner liner and site modification was done on the collar of tile carrier to reduce the outer diameter(ER case ER-20241218-0821). Please find report from the HGP specialist for details. 3.8.1 Inner swirler Inner swirler was replaced with new one. 3.8.2 Burner The burner was found in good condition. The burner was overhauled by the customer crew and pressure test was also conducted successfully.
